# Tasks: Employee Daily Reminders

**Input**: Design documents from `/specs/004-employee-daily-reminders/`

**Prerequisites**: plan.md (required), spec.md (required for user stories), research.md, data-model.md, contracts/

**Tests**: In this project (MacroGest Core), tests are MANDATORY: they validate real business rules with concrete data (Constitution Pr. V) and are generated by `@blendverse-tester` after implementation. Do not plan test tasks. The rules to cover (from `plan.md` "Testing Strategy") are enumerated per story for the tester.

**Organization**: Tasks are grouped by the plan's dependency phases; each task carries the user story label ([US1]..[US7]) it serves, so every story is independently traceable and testable. Back-only feature (no UI). See user-story map in "Dependencies & Execution Order".

## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`

- **[P]**: Can run in parallel (different files, no dependencies)
- **[Story]**: Which user story this task belongs to (set values: US1..US7 — mapped in "User Story Map" below)
- Include exact file paths in descriptions

**Story map (from spec.md)**: US1 email diario individual · US2 documentos sin firmar · US3 términos sin aceptar · US4 renovar contraseña · US5 documentos sin visualizar · US6 notificación en tiempo real · US7 resiliencia multi-tenant. US1..US5 comparten UN mismo batch/email y se agrupan en una sola fase (ver plan.md Phase 1); US6 es la notificación real-time (plan.md Phase 2); US7 se materializa en el `service` y se valida en la fase de integración (plan.md Phase 3).

## Path Conventions

- Web app monorepo: `packages/server/src/...`. No schema changes; no migrations. No UI (spec Q3).
- Domain `EmployeeReminders` (nuevo) + cambios puntuales en `Documents` (existente). Reuso vía DI de `Disclaimer.GetEmployeesByCompany`, `Users.GetAllActiveOwners` (sin cambios).

**Purpose**: Scaffold the new `EmployeeReminders` domain so all later tasks have the folder/barrel layout to fill. No dependency installed (native stack: node-cron, nodemailer, sequelize, awilix, pino, zod).

I) in `packages/server/src/domains/EmployeeReminders/`

## Phase 3: User Story 1–5 — Daily Reminder Email Batch (Priority: P1) 🎯 MVP

**Goal**: Employees receive an individual daily email (9 AM, America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires) listing ONLY their pending actions: unsigned docs (US2), unaccepted terms (US3), renew password (US4), unviewed docs (US5). Email sent only if ≥1 pending (FR-008); skip+log when no valid email (FR-009); resilience per company/employee (FR-003). This group IS the MVP slice.

**Independent Test**: Fire `employeeReminders.sendDailyReminders` (manual trigger) or wait for the cron; assert each active employee with ≥1 pending receives exactly one email addressed to them listing only their own pending, and an employee with no pending gets none (spec US1..US5 acceptance scenarios).

### Tests for User Story 1–5 (generated by `@blendverse-tester` after implementation, Constitution Pr. V) ⚠️

> **NOTE: Do not write test tasks here.** Rules for the tester (from plan.md): `GetPendingDocumentsByEmployee` (#1/#4 with `isUnsigned`/`isUnviewed` flags); `GenerateDailyReminder` assembly (`shouldSend` true with 4 pending, false with none); `SendEmployeeReminderEmail` (only when `shouldSend`, skip+log without valid email); `EmployeeRemindersService` (3 owners, B fails → A and C done); `EmployeeRemindersScheduler` (idempotent `init`, cron 0 9 \* \* \*).

### Implementation

- [ ] T009 [P] [US2] Add the `getPendingDocumentsByEmployee` and `createDocuments` signature + `IPendingDocumentForEmployee` / `IDocumentToCreate` interfaces to the abstract repository in `packages/server/src/domains/Documents/Domain/Document.repository.ts` (createDocuments consumed in US6 phase)
- [ ] T010 [P] [US2] Implement `getPendingDocumentsByEmployee` in `packages/server/src/domains/Documents/Infrastructure/Database/DocumentsRepository.implementation.ts` querying `Documentos.findAll` with `where: { Usuario_id: employeeId, [Op.or]: [{ firmado: null }, { visualizado: null }] }` and `include: [{ model: UserModel, required: true, where: { id_propietario: ownerId } }]`, mapping `isUnsigned`/`isUnviewed` flags
- [ ] T011 [US1] Create `GetPendingDocumentsByEmployee.usecase.ts` in `packages/server/src/domains/Documents/Application/UseCases/` (wraps T010, takes `employeeId` + `requestContext`), export from `Application/UseCases/index.ts` (and `Application/index.ts`) barrels
- [ ] T012 [US1] Register `_getPendingDocumentsByEmployee: asClass(GetPendingDocumentsByEmployee)` in `packages/server/src/domains/Documents/documents.di.ts` (the domain owner registers it; not re-registered anywhere else)
- [ ] T013 [US1] Create `GenerateDailyReminder.usecase.ts` in `packages/server/src/domains/EmployeeReminders/Application/UseCases/` orchestrating cross-domain `_getEmployeesByCompany` (Disclaimer — provides `renovar_clave`, `estado_firma`) + `_getPendingDocumentsByEmployee` (Documents); assemble `IEmployeeReminder` and compute `shouldSend` (FR-008/const)

## Phase 4: User Story 6 — Real-Time New-Document Notification (Priority: P1)

**Goal**: When a document is ingested and assigned to an employee, they receive an immediate email (first assignment); multiple docs in one operation produce a single email.

**Independent Test**: invoke `documents.ingestDocument` with 2 docs for the same employee → one immediate email listing both; doc without `employeeId` → no notification; invalid email → skip+log; SMTP failure → ingest does not fail (spec US6 scenarios).

### Tests for User Story 6 (generated by `@blendverse-tester`) ⚠️

> **NOTE: Do not write test tasks here.** Rules for the tester: `NotifyNewDocument` aggregates several documents into ONE email; no email → skip+log; port error → no rethrow. `IngestDocument` persists and invokes notify; notify failure does not block persistence.

- [ ] T018 [P] [US6] Implement `createDocuments` in `packages/server/src/domains/Documents/Infrastructure/Database/DocumentsRepository.implementation.ts` via `bulkCreate` of `Documentos` with `fecha_de_subida = new Date()`, owner-scoped (Pr. II), returning `{ id, employeeId?, titulo }[]`
- [ ] T019 [US6] Create `NotifyNewDocument.usecase.ts` in `packages/server/src/domains/EmployeeReminders/Application/UseCases/` — single email per employee grouping all their documents in the operation (FR-013), skip+log without valid email (FR-014), catch send errors without rethrowing (FR-015), using `employeeEmailSender` + `emailTemplates.newDocumentNotification`
- [ ] T020 [US6] Create `IngestDocument.usecase.ts` in `packages/server/src/domains/Documents/Application/UseCases/` — canonical document entry point: `createDocuments` (sets payment date, `Usuario_id`, tipo/titulo/archivo/extension), then group created docs by `employeeId` and call `_notifyNewDocument` in `try/catch` (FR-011/FR-013/FR-015), returns `{ documentIds, notified }`; no `employeeId` → no notification (FR-014)
- [ ] T021 [US6] Add `ingestDocument` Zod input schema to `packages/server/src/domains/Documents/Application/documents.types.ts` (`documents: IIngestDocumentItem[]`, no `id_propietario` in schema — Pr. II)
- [ ] T022 [US6] Expose `ingestDocument` mutation (protectedProcedure) in `packages/server/src/domains/Documents/Infrastructure/Controllers/Documents.controller.ts` wired through `documentsService`; add the procedure to `packages/server/src/domains/Documents/Infrastructure/Routes/DocumentsRoutes.ts`
- [ ] T023 [US6] Register DI: `_ingestDocument: asClass(IngestDocument)` in `packages/server/src/domains/Documents/documents.di.ts`, and `_notifyNewDocument: asClass(NotifyNewDocument)` in `packages/server/src/domains/EmployeeReminders/employeeReminders.di.ts` (cross-domain: `_ingestDocument` resolves `_notifyNewDocument` from the flat merge in `register.ts` — Research §5)

**Checkpoint**: Document ingestion triggers an immediate grouped email; ingestDocument never blocks on notification failure.

## Dependencies & Execution Order

### Phase Dependencies

- **Setup (Phase 1)**: No dependencies — start immediately.
- **Foundational (Phase 2)**: Depends on Setup — BLOCKS both stories.
- **User Stories (Phase 3+4)**: depend on Foundational. `IngestDocument`/notify (US6) can begin right after Foundational; both stories may run in parallel across two devs.
- **Integration (Phase 5)**: needs Phase 3 (US1–US5 batch) + Phase 4 (US6) complete, and the compiled `employeeReminders.di.ts`; also the Documents `_ingestDocument` (US6).
- **Polish (Final)**: after all stories complete — runs QA gates/quickstart.

### User Story Map

- **US1 (P1)**: daily batch orchestrator → GenerateDailyReminder, SendEmail, Service, Scheduler. Start after Foundational. Defines token MVP.
- **US2 (P1)** + **US5 (P2)**: docs pending via `getPendingDocumentsByEmployee` (port+DC implementation+use case+DI).
- **US3 (P1)**: terms pending — reads `estado_firma` from Disclaimer `_getEmployeesByCompany` (no new code; consumed in GenerateDailyReminder). No dedicated task: handled in T013.
- **US4 (P2)**: renew password — `renovar_clave` from Disclaimer `_getEmployeesByCompany` (label in T013).
- **US6 (P1)**: document ingestion (IngestDocument, create, notify, controller, tRPC route, DI).
- **US7 (P2)**: resilience in `EmployeeReminders.service` + integration (controller/routes/register index). Validated in tests by @tester.

### Within Each User Story

- Models/DTOs before use cases; use cases before services; services before controller/routes; DI registration right after each new `asClass` key; controllers in integration phase for US7, but the Documents controller for `ingestDocument` lands in US6.

### Parallel Opportunities

- Phase 2: T002/T003/T004/T005 parallel (email infra + DTO + templates — templates after DTO freeze).
- Phase 3: Documents pending (T009..T012) is independent of the EmployeeReminder app use cases (T013..T017) → can run in parallel (two files).
- Phase 4: T018 independent; T019/T020/T021... sequential.
- Phase 5: T024/T025/T026/T027 parallel (different files); T027/T028 sequential (register/router then index).

## Implementation Strategy

### MVP First (US1 + the batch, phase 3 only)

1. Phase 1 Setup (T001).
2. Phase 2 Foundational (T002–T008) — blocking.
3. Phase 3: build the batch (US1–US5) → **STOP and VALIDATE**: trigger `sendDailyReminders` — each employee gets one email with their pending; nobody without pending gets one. Deploy/demo if ready.

### Incremental Delivery

1. The batch (Phase 3) already delivers all 4 pending types (US1–US5) in one slice — the MVP.
2. Add US-6 real-time notification (Phase 4) → validate via `ingestDocument` immediate email.
3. Add US-7 resilience + full DI/controller (Phase 5) → validate multi-tenant logs.
4. Each increment adds value without breaking the previous.

<br>

## Notes

- **[P]** tasks differ in files, no deps — parallelizable.
- **[Story]** maps to spec user story for traceability (values US1..US7).
- Cross-domain keys resolved from owner domains (Disclaimer/Users/Documents) — never re-register; see constitution Pr VII and Register example of `dailyReportApp`.
- Commit after each logical task group (Conventional Commits, scope `employee-reminders`).
- Avoid: vague tasks, file conflicts, cross-story deps that break independence.
